title: Golden cross: S&P 500
summary: Hold SPY while its 50-day average is above the 200-day; step aside when it crosses below. A classic way to sidestep long bear markets.

title: Multi-asset trend
summary: A 20/100-day moving-average trend filter across stocks, bonds, gold and international equities, equal weight.

title: Nasdaq momentum (MACD)
summary: Owns QQQ when MACD crosses above its signal line and exits on the cross down, with a 7% stop-loss.

title: Mega-cap dip buyer
summary: Buys AAPL, MSFT, NVDA or GOOGL when the 14-day RSI is oversold and takes profit at 15%.

title: Small-cap band reversion
summary: Buys IWM when it closes below its lower Bollinger Band and exits at the middle band.

title: Energy breakout
summary: Donchian breakout on XOM and CVX: enter on a new 55-day high, exit on a 20-day low, 8% stop.

title: Dividend ETF trend guard
summary: Holds SCHD and VYM while their 50-day averages stay above the 200-day, with a 12% stop.

title: TradingView day trader
summary: A webhook bot for your own TradingView alerts: half the bot per position, 3% stop, 6% target, flat by 15:55 ET.
